newsitem.title: USA: Wm. Wrigley Jr Co votes extra payout.
newsitem.headline: Wm. Wrigley Jr Co votes extra payout.

text.p: Wm. Wrigley Jr Co said Tuesday its board voted an extra dividend of $0.34 per share, bringing the full-year 1996 dividend to $1.02 per share.
The extra dividend is payable December 16, record December 6.

The gum manufacturer also voted a regular $0.17 per share payout for the three-month period beginning February 3, 1997. Stockholders of record of each share of common and Class B at the close of business January 15, 1997 are entitled to the dividend, Wrigley said.
Wrigley said the extra payout is in keeping with the company's dividend policy of paying out approximately 50 percent of annual earnings.
